_doc: What a traced piece's data-name asks of its model. build.py picks within these; audit.ts checks against them. name: regex on data-name (case-insensitive). height: model height range in metres. not: regex on the model name that is the wrong thing. wall: stands with its back to a wall. faces: regex on the data-name of what it faces in the same room, with the minimum cosine. The first matching role wins. Footprint: width within width_tolerance of the traced width, depth from depth_under below to depth_over above the traced depth (plans draw sofas and TV units shallower than real ones; a shallower wardrobe in a niche blocks nothing).
